description: This file defines the application configuration for a banking application project. It sets up the OpenAPI documentation configuration, replacing an older Swagger setup, and exposes the API documentation and the H2 console endpoint.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up the OpenAPI documentation for the banking application, including API info and external documentation links.

methods.name: bankAppOpenAPI
methods.description: Defines a bean that configures the OpenAPI documentation with title, description, version, and external documentation link to the H2 console.
